coverage.notes: Validates that the email signup route rejects a duplicate address by reusing the seeded standard E2E user email.

preconditions: The local frontend and backend E2E servers are reachable.
The seeded standard E2E user exists with a registered email address.
The run starts in an anonymous state with no active session.
assertions: The register form is visible at /auth/register.
Submitting a valid signup request with the seeded existing email is rejected.
A registration error message is displayed.
The success acceptance panel is not shown after the rejected request.
notes: Uses the environment-backed standard E2E account email as the duplicate target while excluding mailbox access and token verification coverage.
